title: An Infinite BART model
abstract: arXiv:2511.20087v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bayesian additive regression trees (BART) is a popular Bayesian ensemble model used in regression and classification analysis. Under this modeling framework, the regression function is approximated by an ensemble of decision trees, interpreted as weak learners. In this work, we propose a generalization of the BART model that has two main features: first, it automatically selects the number of decision trees using the given data; second, the model allows clusters of observations to have different regression functions since each data point can only use a selection of weak learners, instead of all of them. This model generalization is accomplished by including a binary weight matrix in the conditional distribution of the response variable, which activates only a specific subset of decision trees for each observation. translated_abstract: 贝叶斯加性回归树是回归和分类分析中一种流行的贝叶斯集成模型。在该建模框架下，回归函数由一组决策树的集成来近似，这些决策树被解释为弱学习器。在本工作中，我们提出了BART模型的一个推广，该推广具有两个主要特点：第一，它能够根据给定数据自动选择决策树的数量；第二，该模型允许不同的观测簇拥有不同的回归函数，因为每个数据点只能使用部分弱学习器，而不是全部弱学习器。这一模型推广是通过在响应变量的条件分布中引入一个二值权重矩阵来实现的，该矩阵仅为每个观测激活一个特定的决策树子集。该矩阵被赋予印度自助餐过程先验，并在MCMC采样器中与其他参数一起进行采样。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无限BART模型，通过引入带有印度自助餐过程先验的二值权重矩阵，实现了决策树数量的自动选择，并允许不同观测簇仅使用部分弱学习器从而具有不同的回归函数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an infinite BART model that automatically selects the number of decision trees and allows clusters of observations to have different regression functions by introducing a binary weight matrix endowed with an Indian Buffet process prior.
